name: INVERTED HAMMER
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used to check if a particular candle was an inverted hammer. It is supposed to be used under the position keyword. This keyword has been used as a part of TA lib. You can find more details on the same from the link shared below:

https://www.ta-lib.org/function.html

![Example](./images/img-1632229087.png)

The above example will check if the previous (-1) 5 minute candle of Nifty 50 was an inverted hammer.
